title: The Varsity
scope: Standing original The Varsity restaurant and drive-in on North Avenue in Atlanta with its Streamlined Moderne shopfront, roadside signs, open carhop canopy and rear raised parking deck.
limitations: The standing North Avenue location is modeled. The parking deck section, roof plant, sign lettering, colors, light levels and curving glazing are simplified.
The west roadside sign stands at an approximate position derived from the night street view and operator record. Third-party advertising, interiors, cars and landscaping are outside scope.
